notes.title: Update SEPTEMBER 2021 (v1.0.7)
notes.notes:
Game update to version 1.0.7.

It fixes, or improves, some features that were included in Waifu Discovered 2.

- Novice mode will appear if you have over 10 unsuccessful attempts to save at least 7 girls in Standard mode.
- By request we created a DLC to make the game easier or unlock things. Please, check Exposed DLC  to learn more.
- Leaderboard fixes.
- Title screen different game modes have colours now.
- Title screen also displays current top score (offline).
- Other minor updates.

notes.title: Waifu Uncovered Physical Release for Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
Waifu Uncovered is getting a full physical release on the Nintendo Switch on November 2020!

The game includes an unlockable “fully uncensored mode” and will be packaged with a set of 8 dual-sided art cards. You can preorder from FunBox media, Play asia and many more shops to come.

You can preorder now.

More info:
https://www.funboxmedia.co.uk/waifu-uncovered/

notes.title: ONE LAST UPDATE BEFORE FULL RELEASE...
notes.notes:
WAIFU UNCOVERED is leaving Early Access... 
So we have all features but we can't go into release mode. Why? We need your help! Read below...

First we would like to thank everybody that helped out in the Early Access version....
MANY MANY THANKS TO ALL OF YOU FOR PLAYING THE EARLY ACCESS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36490288/be81dfe0b085056d6cdb504a576c1fafdcedbd94.gif

Once I have thank you all. We are announcing that All Early Access restrictions have been removed:
- All Waifus available.
- All music available.
- One Hand Mode unlockable.
- New game video in Steam.
- New site descriptions.
- More in-game nice details.
- And many many more upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36490288/7efaa086bf2194824a4313fe3ed3e8c3cae019fc.jpg

We need your help.
It's very easy: You only need to tell your friends, here or your social networks twitter / instagram / tik-tok / facebook...

Yeah OK, but why?
It's very important THEY wishlist the game to have some active whishlists on release day to make good noise in Steam. It's also important that YOU leave a positive review! Please do! 

Once we have a few more positive reviews we'll have the thumbs up marker. When that happens we'll release the game.

Obviously, you don't have to do any of this but it would be nice a little bit of help from you. 
Remember we 're a very small studio that have spent a very long time to get you the best experience possible. x

Also, If you find anything that could be improved we're still in time!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36490288/3f8082e8eef4092374a78ae05ca629eda89455a4.gif

Hopefully this will take just a couple of days.
IF YOU CARE ABOUT THIS GAME, PLEASE SHARE AND RATE.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36490288/18d6a6f0f64bc42f7642b62e124be613c6818de5.png

notes.title: UPDATE - BETA: 5 March 2020
notes.notes:
We have added lots of new stuff!!!

UPDATED 3rd MARCH 2020
- New sound effects.
- New ship models.
- New "Declothing hack system". (Related to: "Censor mode")
- K.Vaio interlude fun animations: Shows now in between stages.
- New enemy animations.
- Lots of censor layers' tweaks.
- REMOVED tutorial.
- More slight text corrections and some other boss name changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36490288/d3b79883486d6495c35c8674bd57fc39480daa14.png

We'll continue working on:
- ALL SONGS : SOUNDTRACK REPLACEMENT.
- CHINESE LANGUAGE SUPPORT.

and...
- ONE HAND MODE (internal testing)
- EXTRA SHIP (for one hand mode).
- EXTRA WAIFU and EXTRA BOSS. (completed, we will add after Early Access)


We changed our terms. Since we are adding so much more stuff we might need to rise the game price after Early Access. So if you are considering buying the game, now it's the time!


Please let us know if everything works well.
Don't forget you can ask for more features. We will evaluate if they are worth we'll work on them right after (as you can see).

Download it now. Enjoy!
